name: Timeless
description: Connect Claude to your meeting memory. Ask or build anything from your spoken data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Timeless to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Timeless to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.timeless.day/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Timeless MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timeless provides these MCP tools: create_webhook, delete_webhook, get_document, get_meeting_recording, get_meeting_transcript, list_meetings, list_rooms, list_webhooks, and update_webhook.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Timeless?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Timeless in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Timeless requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Timeless is developed by Timeless. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
